[Protect the Royal Line](/Feats.aspx?ID=7411) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Mythic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=835" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 136

**Archetype** [Prophesied Monarch](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=294)

**Prerequisites**
[Prophesied Monarch Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=7403)

**Requirements**
You’re [flanked](/Rules.aspx?ID=2375) by at least two enemies.

</column>

---

You must keep your royal person safe from harm, especially when surrounded by those who would dare approach you. Attempt an [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) check to [Reposition](/Actions.aspx?ID=2379) or [Shove](/Actions.aspx?ID=2380) one of the enemies who’s [flanking](/Rules.aspx?ID=2375) you. If you can see at least one of your designated knights, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this check; this bonus increases to +4 if one of your designated knights is adjacent to you. If you succeed, you get a critical success. If your roll would’ve been a critical success, you increase the distance you Reposition or Shove the enemy by 5 feet.

You can break your spells down into raw magical potential and transfer it to an ally. Expend one prepared spell, spell slot, or [Focus](/Rules.aspx?ID=285) Point, and choose an adjacent ally or an ally within your _spellsurge_ aura. If you expended a spell or spell slot, the ally regains one expended spell or spell slot with a rank equal to or lower than the spell or spell slot you expended. </title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Investigator" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=818" />
<trait label="Rogue" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=687" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 177 <sup>2.0</sup>, [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 113 <sup>1.1</sup>

</column>

---

You spend 1 minute surveying a small location (such as a single room) to get an impression of events that occurred there in the last day. This involves moving about the area and studying footprints, spilled drinks or blood, and so forth. You get an indistinct mental impression of significant events that happened there. This gives you clues and details of the past, including the overall events and their time frame, but it’s not a perfect record. This also isn’t enough to identify who was involved in these events if you weren’t already aware the person was there. As determined by the GM, you also pick out various seemingly small details that could serve as important clues, like a memorable weapon someone used for a murder or the type of cloak someone wore when passing through.
name: Reconstruct The Scene

</title>

<traits>

<trait label="Linguistic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=642" />

**Prerequisites**
[Broken Chain Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=7357)

</column>

---

You peer into the eyes of a target of your [Ultimatum of Liberation](/Actions.aspx?ID=2993), as you say aloud the names of their victims, searing them into the oppressor’s mind, cursing them to feel their victims’ pain. The target takes 12d6 mental damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher). If the target fails or critically fails this check, they also take 2d6 [persistent mental damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86). For the next hour, when the target stops taking this persistent damage, you or one of your allies can mention a victim’s name as a single action to the target, forcing them to succeed at another Will save or begin taking the persistent damage again. This is a [curse](/Traits.aspx?ID=566) effect. Once you use Remember Their Names on a target, the target is immune to it for 24 hours.
name: Remember thy Names

[Ruthless Orator](/Feats.aspx?ID=7465) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Auditory" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=541" />
<trait label="Emotion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=590" />
<trait label="Linguistic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=642" />
<trait label="Mental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=647" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rival Academies](/Sources.aspx?ID=235) pg. 58

**Archetype** [Kitharodian Actor](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=301)

**Frequency**
once per hour

**Prerequisites**
[Kitharodian Actor Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=7456)

</column>

---

You were once cast in the role of Daronlyr XII, one of Taldor’s most ambitious rulers who slew his cousin to seize the crown, yet somehow still managed to convince the entire Ulfen Guard to swear loyalty to him simply through his powers of oration. You attempt a Performance check to launch into a powerful monologue, pulling lines from Daronlyr’s playbook to win respect from everyone around you, even your enemies. The DC of this check is a [hard difficulty DC](/Rules.aspx?ID=2627) of your level. On a success, any hostile creatures within 20 feet take a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and spell attack rolls that target you until the beginning of your next turn, and any allies within 20 feet are quickened until the beginning of your next turn. The additional action can be only used to Strike or Stride.
name: Ruthless Orator

>
[Scintillating Spell](/Feats.aspx?ID=5048) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Light" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=100" />
<trait label="Sorcerer" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=824" />
<trait label="Spellshape" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=513" />
<trait label="Wizard" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=735" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 204 <sup>2.0</sup>, [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 157 <sup>1.1</sup>

**Archetype** [Wellspring Mage](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=104) (Level 16)

---

Your spells become a radiant display of light and color. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that doesn’t have the darkness trait, has no duration, and requires creatures to attempt a Reflex save, the spell explodes in a spray of scintillating lights, in addition to its other effects. Each creature that failed its Reflex save against the spell is dazzled for 1 round, and those who critically failed are instead blinded for 1 round.
name: Scintillating Spell

<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 16"
    pfs=""
>
[Seat of Power](/Feats.aspx?ID=7326) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Mythic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=835" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 112

**Archetype** [Archfiend](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=288)

**Prerequisites**
[Archfiend Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=7320)

</column>

---

Your sheer determination has created a demiplane that houses a grand residence which will serve as the heart of your planned realm. You determine the appearance of this seat of power, such as a duskwood longhouse, a crumbling stone castle, an ice tower, or a pagoda constructed from the solidified souls of the damned. You can enter your realm using the Enter Seat of Power activity. You and any creatures you choose gain three times as many Hit Points when [resting](/Rules.aspx?ID=2601) within your seat of power. Once per day while within your seat of power, you can cast [_cleanse affliction_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1467) as a 4th-rank innate [divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2) spell or [_sound body_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1679) as a 4th-rank innate divine spell. You can target only yourself with these spells. 

**Enter Seat of Power** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [exploration](/Skills.aspx?ID=23), [mythic](/Traits.aspx?ID=835)) **Effect** You focus your mind on your seat of power, then tap into this connection to transport yourself to its demiplane. This process takes 10 minutes. You can bring up to 10 willing creatures with you when you Enter Seat of Power; these creatures must remain within 30 feet of you for the duration of the activity.

 You can remain in your seat of power for as long as you desire. Any creature that you bring to your seat of power in this way (including you) can depart the demiplane as a three-action activity that has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561) trait. They return to the location they were in when they Entered your Seat of Power, or the nearest unoccupied space if that location is occupied.
name: Seat of Power

</title>

<traits>

<trait label="Ikon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=840" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 41

</column>

---

Your ikon is connected to the world of the spirits, allowing you to partially fade into their realm. The imbued ikon gains the following ability. 

 **Transcendence—Skirt the Underworld** <actions string="Two Actions" /> (concentrate, illusion, incapacitation, transcendence) You skirt into the world of the dead, becoming [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=83) for 1 round, then Fly up to your Speed. >
[Spell Tinker](/Feats.aspx?ID=5049) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Wizard" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=735" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 205 <sup>2.0</sup>

</column>

---

You’ve learned to alter choices you make when casting spells on yourself. After casting a spell on only yourself that offers several choices of effect (such as resist energy or a polymorph spell that offers several potential forms), you can alter the choice you made when Casting the Spell (for instance, choosing a different type of damage for resist energy).

You can’t use this feat if the benefits of the spell have already been used up or if the effects of the first choice would persist in any way after switching (for instance, if one of the choices was to create a consumable item you already used, or to heal you), or if the feat would create an effect more powerful than that offered by the base spell. The GM is the final arbiter of what Spell Tinker can be applied to.
name: Spell Tinker

[Stand Firm](/Feats.aspx?ID=7368) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Auditory" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=541" />
<trait label="Linguistic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=642" />
<trait label="Mythic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=835" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 124

**Archetype** [Broken Chain](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=291)

**Prerequisites**
[Broken Chain Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=7357)

</column>

---

Your words help your ally shake off unease and terror. You shout a bolstering comment at an ally within 30 feet of you who has the [fleeing](/Conditions.aspx?ID=74) or [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) condition and can hear you. That ally reduces the value of their frightened condition by 2 (to a minimum of 0). If they are fleeing, they can immediately attempt a new saving throw against the effect that caused the condition. If that save is a failure, but not a critical failure, the ally needs to spend one fewer action on their turn to escape the source of the fleeing condition. This allows that ally to [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) or [Cast a one-action Spell](/Actions.aspx?ID=2734) that doesn’t necessarily get them further away from the source, but the ally still has the fleeing condition and can’t [Delay](/Actions.aspx?ID=2294) or [Ready](/Actions.aspx?ID=2299) as usual. If the ally is under an effect that reduces the number of actions they have on their turn, they don’t gain this benefit on a failed saving throw. Once you use Stand Firm on an ally, that ally is immune to it until the beginning of your next turn.
name: Stand Firm

<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 16"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Strike Rivers, Seize Winds](/Feats.aspx?ID=7187) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Exemplar" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=839" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 41

**Frequency**
once per hour

</column>

---

Through sheer physical force, you can wrestle a river, lasso the winds, punch a hole to the molten center of the planet, or create other environmental disturbances via nothing but your own strength. You can create each of the following spell effects at the listed rank, but you can’t create effects more than once per hour and you can’t perform a given effect more than once per day: **4th** [_hydraulic torrent_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1562), **5th** [_control water_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1473), **6th** [_howling blizzard_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1559), **7th** [_volcanic eruption_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1746), **8th** [_punishing winds_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1643).

Creating the effects requires the same type and number of actions as Casting the Spell, and they use the higher of your class DC or spell DC when appropriate. Because you are creating these effects with your godly might rather than Casting a Spell, they can’t be dispelled or counteracted.
name: Strike Rivers, Seize Winds

<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #204: Stage Fright](/Sources.aspx?ID=245) pg. 83

**Archetypes** [Acrobat](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=236) (Level 16), [Gladiator](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=251) (Level 16)

once per hour

You are always ready to embrace to a change in tempo and adapt your actions to take advantage of unforeseen developments. prerequisite: Celebrity Dedication or Gladiator Dedication; Legendary in Acrobatics

>
[Terrifying Mien](/Feats.aspx?ID=7383) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Mythic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=835" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 128

**Archetype** [Eternal Legend](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=292)

**Prerequisites**
[Eternal Legend Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=7374); Master in [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40)

</column>

---

Whether they have heard of your legend or seen your prowess on the field of battle, those already quaking in their boots grow weak when forced to stand against you. You gain [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage against [Strikes](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) made by creatures with the [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) condition. This resistance is equal to four times the value of that creature’s frightened condition. When this resistance applies to at least one of a creature’s Strikes during their turn, that creature doesn’t reduce the value of their frightened condition at the end of their turn.
name: Terrifying Mien
prerequisite: Eternal Legend Dedication; Master in Intimidation

[The Bitter Scholar's Promotion](/Feats.aspx?ID=7093) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Tian Xia Character Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=230) pg. 115

**Archetype** [Cultivator](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=278)

**Prerequisites**
[Ghost-path Epiphany](/Feats.aspx?ID=7091)

</column>

---

Tian Xia’s shining cities belie its empires’ long shadow of death, darkened by thousands of years of suffering and injustice. You pursue immortality not through tuft-hunting with Heaven’s dragons or their imperial brats; yours is the power to crack its corrupt wheel, for you can now release the ghost gates to expedite the dead’s revenge at being cheated of their fates. 

You cease aging and, regardless of your actual existential state, now register as an [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=722) to effects that can detect undead (such as [lifesense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=67) or spiritsense). In addition, you learn [_create undead_](/Rituals.aspx?ID=117) rituals for [gashadokuro](/Monsters.aspx?ID=1860), [jiangshi](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=286), and [shui gui](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2784). On a success with one of these rituals, you gain the effects of a critical success instead.
name: The Bitter Scholar's Promotion

>
[The Immortal Attains the Summit](/Feats.aspx?ID=7094) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Tian Xia Character Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=230) pg. 115

**Archetype** [Cultivator](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=278)

**Prerequisites**
[Three Pecks of Dew](/Feats.aspx?ID=7092)

</column>

---

Your cultivation bearing glorious fruit, you behold Heaven’s will. Returning from your vision of the Holy Mountain, you become an immortal with mystic potency over the terrestrial realms of wind and water.

You cease aging and, regardless of your actual existential state, now register as a living being to effects that can detect living creatures (such as [lifesense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=67) or spiritsense). 

In addition, you learn the [_control weather_](/Rituals.aspx?ID=116) and [_plant growth_](/Rituals.aspx?ID=121) rituals. You can use [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=44) instead of [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43) for these rituals. On a success with one of these rituals, you gain the effects of a critical success instead.
name: The Immortal Attains the Summit

Those who critically fail the save are also knocked prone.
**Failure** All creatures within a 10-foot radius burst centered on you take sonic damage equal to your level (basic Fortitude saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher). Those who fail the save are also knocked prone.

    level="1"

    pfs=""
>
[To War!](/Feats.aspx?ID=7312) <actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Mythic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=835" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 108

**Archetype** [Apocalypse Rider](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=287)

**Frequency**
once per 10 minutes

**Prerequisites**
[Apocalypse Rider Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=7304)

**Requirements**
You are riding your apocalypse [mount](/Actions.aspx?ID=2314).

</column>

---

You inspire your allies to greater battle prowess while trampling enemies in your way. You Command your apocalypse mount to [Stride](/Actions.aspx?ID=2305) up to twice its Speed (or to [Burrow](/Actions.aspx?ID=2310), [Climb](/Actions.aspx?ID=2374), [Fly](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312), or [Swim](/Actions.aspx?ID=2381), if it has the corresponding movement type), moving through the space of any foes in your path up to one size smaller than your apocalypse mount. Your mount deals damage equal to one of its unarmed attack [Strikes](/Actions.aspx?ID=1167) to each creature whose space you move through (basic Reflex save against your apocalypse mount’s [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) DC). On a critical failure, the creature also becomes [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) until the end of your next turn. You can damage a given creature only once during this movement.

In addition, all allies who witnessed your charge gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level and a +2 status bonus to damage against any foe damaged by your apocalypse mount this round. This has the [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727) trait. These benefits last until the end of your next turn.

    pfs="Standard"
>
[Too Much to Swallow](/Feats.aspx?ID=5408) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Druid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=583" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 57 <sup>2.1</sup>

**Prerequisites**
[Untamed Form](/Feats.aspx?ID=4713)

**Trigger**
You’re subject to an effect you could attempt to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296).

</column>

---

While you might be small enough to grab normally, you can change that at a moment's notice. You cast [_untamed form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1861). If you took on a new form that's too large for the effect, you automatically escape. Otherwise, you attempt to Escape. If this ends an effect where you entered the creature's space, such as [Swallow Whole](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=77), exit that creature to an adjacent area where your new form could fit.

---

After you've grasped a creature with your lash, you swing them around like a whirling hammer, smashing them into all nearby enemies. Make a melee Strike against each enemy within your melee reach. Your last attack must be against the grabbed creature, and you gain a circumstance bonus to your attack roll equal to the number of enemies you slammed them into, to a maximum of +3. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but don't increase your penalty until you have made all your attacks. After your Whirling Clobber, you release the grabbed or restrained creature into an open square within reach of your lash.

**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 108 **Archetype** [Apocalypse Rider](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=287) **Frequency** once per 10 minutes **Prerequisites** [Apocalypse Rider Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=7304); [Battle Harbinger Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=7505) --- You hasten the passage of time for a living creature, prematurely aging them into decrepitude. A living creature within 60 feet takes 14d6 [void](/Traits.aspx?ID=510) damage and a part of its body you chose withers, taking the following penalties depending on the result of their a Fortitude saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.
  • **Arms** The target’s arms grow weak. The target becomes [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71) 1.
  • **Head** The target has trouble thinking straight. The target becomes [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) 1.
  • **Legs** The target’s legs buckle with every movement. The target takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds.
  • **Torso** The target’s skin becomes thin and papery. The target gains [weakness](/Rules.aspx?ID=2317) 10 to slashing damage.
**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.
**Success** The target takes half damage and the withering penalty lasts until the end of your next turn.
**Failure** The creature takes full damage and the withering penalty lasts for 1 minute.
**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage, and you can choose a second part of the body to wither. Both penalties last for 1 minute.
name: Wither Away
prerequisite: Apocalypse Rider Dedication; Battle Harbinger Dedication

The sight of you charging forward into battle emboldens your allies to follow. You Stride up to twice your Speed and make a horns melee Strike. If your Strike hits and damages an enemy, each ally within 60 feet who saw you hit can use a reaction to Stride up to twice their Speed, but each must end their Stride closer to you than where they started. Each such ally that Strides gains a +1 status bonus to their first Strike on their next turn.

Before your soul returned to the Material Plane, you interacted with a host of other souls on their way to the Boneyard. One of these acquaintances owes you a favor. You can temporarily summon it to come to your aid, and it appears as a swirling mass of ectoplasm with indiscernible features and a translucent dagger, the favored weapon of Pharasma. This functions as [_spiritual guardian_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1688), which you can cast once per day as a divine innate spell, but you don't need to worship a deity to do so.

You give a shrill whistle and point, and a massive swarm of rats pours forth from the surrounding terrain to fill a 30-foot burst within 120 feet. The rats scurry over the ground and climb up walls and surfaces, biting and clawing as they deal 6d8 piercing damage to all enemies in the area. The rats continue to swarm in the area for the next minute, dealing 3d8 piercing damage to any enemy that ends its turn in the area and transforming the area into [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453) (though the rats allow you and your allies to pass normally). You can Dismiss the effect.

You call upon Mother Earth and Father Moon to fill you with light. A cocoon of moonlight momentarily envelops you, and you emerge in a towering form made of swirling energy, tattooed in stardust and clad in regalia of silver and mother of pearl. When you use this ability, you gain the benefits of both the 4th-rank [_enlarge_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1514) and [_fly_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1534) spells. This form lasts for 5 minutes or until you use this action again to return to your normal form.

If you have your head gem, it radiates an aura of moonlight, causing creatures that start their turn adjacent to you to become [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=65) until the beginning of their turn unless they succeed at a Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

If the target is in an area of darkness when the spell is cast, the created duplicate has 15 more Hit Points.

You channel the blessings of Nalinivati to transform into a manifestation of her will. You can cast 5th-rank animal form as an [occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=662) innate spell once per day, but you can choose only snake form with the spell. You were once born from the energies of the land and nature, and by their power, you can return to life again. Once per year, when you die, your remains become protected as if under the effects of a 5th-rank [_peaceful rest_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1625) spell. If your remains are brought and buried within 1 mile of where you were born, after a week, you return to life with the effects of a successful (but not critically successful) 9th-rank [_resurrect_](/Rituals.aspx?ID=123) ritual.

The connection between you and the [First World](/Planes.aspx?ID=10) resonates within your body stronger than it does for most gnomes, allowing you to cross the threshold between [the Universe](/Planes.aspx?ID=1) and the First World. You gain [_interplanar teleport_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1576) as a primal innate spell. You can cast it twice per week. This can be used only to travel back and forth between the First World and the Universe. Due to your body's natural resonance, you can act as a locus for the spell, and you don't require a specially attuned planar key.

    pfs="Limited"
>
[Irresistible Bloom](/Feats.aspx?ID=7620) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Wardens of Wildwood</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Emotion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=60" />
<trait label="Incapacitation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=93" />
<trait label="Mental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=106" />
<trait label="Olfactory" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=246" />
<trait label="Visual" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=163" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root](/Sources.aspx?ID=242) pg. 70

**Frequency**
once per day

**Prerequisites**
[ardande](/Traits.aspx?ID=498) or [plant](/Traits.aspx?ID=668)

</column>

---

You bloom, sprouting flowers and releasing a pleasant smell, becoming irresistible. All creatures in a 30-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) must attempt a Will save with a DC equal to your Class DC or Spell DC, whichever is higher. On a failure, a creature becomes [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=72) with you, and must spend at least one of its actions on its next turn moving toward you. On a critical failure, you acting [hostile](/Conditions.aspx?ID=80) to that creature allows them to attempt another save, rather than automatically ending the fascination.

These effects last until the beginning of your next turn. You can spend one action at the beginning of your turn to [Sustain](/Actions.aspx?ID=2317) the effects for an additional round. You can Sustain it in this way for a maximum of 1 minute.

**Special** This feat gains the trait for your ancestry.
name: Irresistible Bloom
primary_source_raw: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 70

The tentacles' [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296) DC and AC are both equal to the higher of your class DC or spell DC. A creature can attack a tentacle to attempt to free the creature trapped by it; a tentacle is destroyed if it takes 30 or more damage in a single round.
**Critical Failure** As failure, but double damage.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 17"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Landscape Form](/Feats.aspx?ID=6947) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Tanuki" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=830" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Tian Xia Character Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=230) pg. 69

**Frequency**
once per day

</column>

---

While walking down the road on a moonlit night, one might be puzzled to find a shop or hill that wasn’t there before. In reality, this is a tanuki at the height of their power. When you Change Shape, you can transform into a building or terrain feature up to 50 feet tall and up to 50 feet on a side. Mundane features of your landscape form function as normal—for instance, if you transform into a hot spring, the hot spring contains relaxing hot water, and if you transform into an inn, the inn contains bedrooms, beds, and delicious food—though no aspect of your landscape form can be an active hazard that can cause damage or impose conditions, and any objects created within your landscape form turn into leaves if taken outside of it. You can speak while in landscape form, but you can’t attack, cast spells, or move. You can remain in landscape form for up to 8 hours, and when you exit landscape form, it dissolves around anyone who was inside of it.
name: Landscape Form

You unleash the pent-up chaos within you, becoming a nexus of unbridled destruction that wreaks unfettered havoc on everyone in your vicinity. Each creature within 15 feet of you takes 14d6 acid, electricity, or sonic damage, chosen randomly for each target. Each target receives a basic Reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC, but any creature that is subjected to the type of damage for which you currently have resistance through your Proteankin lineage takes a –2 penalty to the save. Any target that critically fails the save is also confused until the end of their next turn.

</title>

<traits>

<trait label="Occult" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=662" />

[Glorious Gamtu](/Feats.aspx?ID=6828)

</column>

---

Your hat embodies the illusory grandeur of a master dokkaebi. Your gamtu now grants its wearer a +1 item bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) checks when worn, and its Hat Trick activation can grant your choice of 2nd-rank [_invisibility_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1577) or 6th-rank _invisibility_.

In addition, the gamtu can be removed while Hat Trick is activated. Doing so removes the effects of invisibility from the original wearer, but the spell doesn’t end. Instead, the effect continues to elapse; if another creature puts the gamtu on, they’re immediately affected by _invisibility_, which lasts for the remaining duration of Hat Trick.

<traits>

<trait label="Goblin" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=81" />

</column>

---

Despite a lifetime filled with questionable decisions, you've managed to survive, as though you have uncanny luck that lets you avoid the consequences of your own actions. For the remainder of your turn, if you roll a failure or critical failure on a saving throw against a harmful effect, you get a success instead. Further, if you would take damage from an enemy or hazard this turn you take the minimum possible damage.

These benefits apply only to harmful effects incurred entirely during your turn in which you activate Reckless Abandon, such as running through a [_wall of fire_](/Spells.aspx?ID=362). Persistent damage and conditions that were applied prior to your turn proceed normally, and as soon as your turn ends you are subject to the full consequences of any dangers still threatening you.
name: Reckless Abandon (Goblin)

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Leshy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=639" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Tian Xia Character Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=230) pg. 43

</column>

---

Once per month, when you die, you can instead choose to fade away. Your corpse is swallowed by the earth, leaving behind only a seed. This seed is very fragile with an AC of 10 and only 1 Hit Point. Another creature can spend 1 minute to plant the seed in a safe space and water it. If so cared for, the next morning a tree grows from it with a single large fruit or flower bud that splits open to reveal you, alive and returned to maximum Hit Points.

You go into hibernation for twenty-four hours and perform a ritual dedicated to your ancestors, undergoing a one-time metamorphosis. </title>

<traits>
<trait label="Wayang" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=831" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Tian Xia Character Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=230) pg. 75

**Prerequisites**
[Inherit the Dreaming Heirloom](/Feats.aspx?ID=6951)

</column>

---

As you whisper to your pusaka, it attempts to cut away an enemy’s shadow, leaving them in an eternal sleep. Your pusaka gains the following Activation. 

**Activate—Cut the Shadow** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** Your pusaka becomes a [kris](/Weapons.aspx?ID=264) made of darkness and drives itself into an adjacent enemy’s shadow. That enemy takes 80 mental damage with a basic Fortitude save against your spell DC or class DC, whichever is higher. If this reduces the creature to 0 Hit Points, the target doesn’t die, but its shadow is severed from its body, becoming a [shadow spawn](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3186) that attempts to flee from the target’s body. As long as the shadow spawn exists, the target remains in a dreamless slumber; if destroyed, the target regains its shadow and awakens (if its body was kept properly while [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=95)).
name: Sever the Dreaming Shadow

[Shadow Self](/Feats.aspx?ID=4473) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Halfling" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=87" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 61 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Frequency**
once per hour

**Prerequisites**
Legendary in [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15)

**Trigger**
You successfully use Stealth to Hide and become hidden from all your current foes, or use Stealth to Sneak and become undetected to all your current foes

</column>

---

You slip from your adversaries' notice and appear to be somewhere else. You become [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=26) for 1 minute or until you take a hostile action, whichever comes first. Choose a location within 10 feet of you. Until your invisibility ends, you appear to be [hidden](/Conditions.aspx?ID=22) in that location to anyone trying to find you. If the searcher gets clear evidence that you're not there, they no longer think you're hidden there, but they don't discover your actual location.
name: Shadow Self

<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 17"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Starshot Arrow](/Feats.aspx?ID=5342) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Attack" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=540" />
<trait label="Centaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=747" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 33 <sup>2.1</sup>

</column>

---

The greatest centaurs need not wait until their stories are over to touch the stars in the sky. You draw an arrow (or other ammunition), whisper a short invocation over it, and then Strike with a ranged weapon. The arrow becomes a bolt of starlight, changing its damage to your choice of force or spirit and granting it the effects of the [_ghost touch_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2840) rune. When the arrow Strikes its target, it unravels into a constellation of starlight that wraps around the target's limbs, imposing a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 2d4 rounds or [immobilizing](/Conditions.aspx?ID=81) it if the Strike was critical hit. The target can untangle itself by spending an Interact action to break free.
name: Starshot Arrow

<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 17"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Start the Festival!](/Feats.aspx?ID=6948) <actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Tanuki" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=830" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Tian Xia Character Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=230) pg. 69

**Frequency**
once per day

</column>

---

No distance can stop tanuki from making their way to a good party. You whistle and point, and 808 tanuki, in their raccoon dog forms, somehow appear from the surrounding terrain and fill a 30-foot [burst](/Rules.aspx?ID=2385) within 120 feet. The tanuki scurry over the ground, leap through the air, and climb up walls and surfaces, dealing 6d8 bludgeoning damage to all enemies in the area as they’re trampled and danced upon. The tanuki continue to party in the area for the next minute, dealing 3d8 bludgeoning damage to any enemy that ends its turn in the area and transforming the area into [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) (though the tanuki allow you and your allies to pass normally). Creatures in raccoon dog form can attempt to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404) within the mass of tanuki. After 1 minute, the tanuki clap 30 times and run off to the next party. You can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) the effect, though if you do, the tanuki grumble as the party ends early.
name: Start the Festival!

Within all surkis is the capacity to be whatever they need to be, and you can tap into that capacity even now. When you sleep, you can choose to enter a pupa state. If you had one or more evolutions for that heritage, you can choose a different evolution for your new heritage.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Ardande" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=498" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Plant" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=125" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
<trait label="Wood" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=508" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 49 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Frequency**
once per hour

**Trigger**
A creature targets you with an attack.

</column>

---

With a sweep of your hand, vines and roots burst from the ground along the edge of your space between you and the attacker, creating a natural lattice of wood that grants [standard cover](/Rules.aspx?ID=459). The circumstance bonus from the cover applies to your AC when you're determining the outcome of the triggering attack. If the triggering attack still hits and deals physical damage to you, the ward reduces the damage by 30 and is immediately destroyed. If the attack misses, the ward instead persists for 3 rounds before withering back into the earth. Creatures can cross the ward, but it's [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453).
name: Wood Ward

Even alone, you’re a force to be reckoned with— an army of one, so long as you have your celestial armaments. Spend 1 Mythic Point. If you’re not currently wielding your celestial armament, it immediately teleports into your hand. With a gesture and a whispered prayer, you launch your celestial armament into the air, where it flies with a mind of its own, attacking every enemy within your nimbus. Make a [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) with that weapon against each enemy in the [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=2402) of your nimbus. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but your penalty doesn’t increase until you have made all your attacks. After these attacks are complete, your weapon returns to your hand.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 18"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Beasts of Slumbering Steel](/Feats.aspx?ID=4264) <actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Metal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=505" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 31 <sup>2.0</sup>

</column>

---

You conjure metal elemental mounts made of interlocking metal pieces. Target up to 5 Medium or smaller willing creatures within 30 feet. Large mounts appear underneath them, and the targets can immediately [Mount](/Actions.aspx?ID=96) the creatures. Each mount can take four different forms. One form has only a land Speed of 80 feet, and the other forms each have a land Speed of 30 feet with a climb, fly, or swim Speed of 60 feet. Each rider chooses the initial form and can change the form as a single action, which has the [concentration](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) trait.

 The mounts have AC 40, Fortitude +30, Reflex +30, Will +25, and 180 Hit Points. They're [mindless](/Traits.aspx?ID=108) and immune to bleed, [healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=89), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), and [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=145). They can't attack. They remain for 1 minute or until you use this impulse again. You can use this impulse as a 1-minute [exploration](/Skills.aspx?ID=23) activity to make the duration 1 hour, but this halves the mounts' defenses and HP.
name: Beasts of Slumbering Steel

    level="1"
    right="Feat 18"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Branched Tree Of Pain](/Feats.aspx?ID=7188) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Exemplar" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=839" />
<trait label="Ikon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=840" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 41

</column>

---

The blade of your ikon takes one or more notches, capable of dealing mortal pain to your foes.

**Immanence** When you Strike with the ikon, you critically succeed if you roll a 19 on the die as long as that result would be a success. This has no effect on a 19 if the result would be a failure.

Transcendence—Plant Thirty Barbs <actions string="Single Action" /> (death, transcendence) You snap off a fragment of your ikon within your opponent’s body, which threatens to burst into numerous barbs. Make a Strike with your ikon. If successful, barbs fill the target, dealing two die of weapon damage the first time the creature uses a move action on each of its turns; the barbs are made out of the same material as your weapon ikon and bypass resistances and such accordingly (for instance, a cold iron spear would create cold iron barbs). The barbs last for 1d4 rounds. If the target dies while the barbs are still in their body, the barbs burst forth in a forest of thorns covering the creature’s space, which are greater difficult terrain and deal piercing damage equal to half your level for each square that is moved into.
name: Branched Tree Of Pain

<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 18"
    pfs=""
>
[Brandish Authority](/Feats.aspx?ID=7327) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Auditory" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=541" />
<trait label="Mythic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=835" />
<trait label="Visual" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=727" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 112

**Archetype** [Archfiend](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=288)

**Prerequisites**
[Archfiend Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=7320)

</column>

---

With a terrifying pronouncement, you manifest a visible sign of your authority and fiendish power, such as a crown of flame upon your brow, a scepter forged of solidified souls, or a throne comprised of a dozen dragon skulls. This object appears in your space or in your hand, as appropriate, and remains for 1 minute. When your sign of power appears, attempt an [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) check to [Demoralize](/Actions.aspx?ID=2395) each enemy within 30 feet who can see or hear you. These Demoralize attempts don’t take any penalty for not sharing a language. As long as your sign of power remains manifested, your enemies can’t reduce the value of their [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) condition below 1.

You can spend 1 [Mythic Point](/Rules.aspx?ID=3320) as part of performing this action; if you do, frightened creatures grovel before you, in awe of your terrible power. At the beginning of their turn, a creature that has the frightened condition from Brandish Authority must attempt a Will saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. On failure, they must Drop Prone. On a critical failure, they must [Drop Prone](/Actions.aspx?ID=2295) and can’t Stand this turn.
name: Brandish Authority

**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 120 **Archetype** [Beast Lord](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=290) **Prerequisites** [Beast Lord Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=7345); you have a united companion with a [specialization](/Rules.aspx?ID=2120). --- Your specialized united companion grows with unparalleled power and strength, becoming a creature of myth. It gains one of the following effects.
  • **Baleful Body** Your united companion’s blood is boiling, its mechanical fluid is acidic, or its insides are otherwise destructive to the touch. Choose [acid](/Traits.aspx?ID=524), [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604), or [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669). If your united companion would take damage from a melee attack, it deals half your level in damage of the chosen type to the creature that made the melee attack. By spending a Mythic Point when you Command your united companion, your united companion can spew its corrosive power as a 2-action activity to deal 14d6 damage of the chosen type in a 15-foot [cone](/Rules.aspx?ID=2386) or 30-foot [line](/Rules.aspx?ID=2388) ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher).
  • **Chimeric Heads** Your united companion sprouts an extra head which gives it extra eyes and allows it to make additional attacks with related unarmed attacks. Your united companion gains [all-around vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=49). By spending a Mythic Point when you Command your united companion, your united companion can make two [Strikes](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) with its unarmed attacks as a single action, each using its current multiple attack penalty. Both Strikes must have the same target. If both attacks hit, combine their damage, and then add any other applicable effects. This counts as one attack when calculating your united companion’s multiple attack penalty. Your united companion must have a head and at least one unarmed attack that uses its mouth or head (such as a beak, jaws, or mandible attack) to select this.
  • **Energy Aegis** Your united companion is protected from hazardous energy. Your united companion becomes [immune](/Rules.aspx?ID=2312) to your choice of acid, [cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=555), [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=586), or fire. Your companion gains a +1 status bonus to AC and saves that originate from creatures with the listed trait and to effects and spells with the listed trait. By spending a Mythic Point when you Command your united companion, your united companion can take a single action with the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561) trait to extend these same benefits to all creatures who are adjacent to it until the beginning of your next turn.
  • **Magnificent Flight** Your united companion grows wings or learns some other method of flight. Your united companion gains a [Fly speed](/Rules.aspx?ID=2350) equal to its Speed and it gains the [mount](/Actions.aspx?ID=2314) special ability. If your united companion already had the mount special ability or a Fly speed equal to its Speed, it instead increases its Speed by 10 feet. By spending a Mythic Point when you Command your united companion, your united companion can, as a two-action activity, Fly up to twice its speed and make a single unarmed melee attack at any point along the way.
  • **Protective Skin** Your united companion is hardened by the infused magic of otherworldly powers. Its maximum Hit Points increase by 30 but it gains a [weakness](/Rules.aspx?ID=2317) of 10 to either [cold iron](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2916) or [silver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2920). By spending a Mythic Point when you Command your united companion, your united companion gains [fast healing](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=62) equal to your level for 1 minute.
name: Creature of Myth
prerequisite: Beast Lord Dedication; you have a united companion with a specialization.

  • You gain a +10-foot status bonus to all your Speeds.
  • Your air [Elemental Blasts](/Actions.aspx?ID=2125) deal an additional 1d12 electricity damage.

</column>

---

The servants of apocalypse know that it is impossible to cheat death, but your will is sufficient to help you outlive even your strongest enemies. The first time each day you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed, you avoid being knocked out and instead of taking the damage, you regain a number of Hit Points equal to twice your level. Your [wounded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=99) condition increases by 1.

 In addition, whenever you have the wounded condition, you gain a status bonus to your Armor Class equal to your wounded condition value and a status bonus to the damage of your [Strikes](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) equal to twice your wounded condition value.

>
[Decree of War](/Feats.aspx?ID=7413) <actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Auditory" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=541" />
<trait label="Mythic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=835" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 137

**Archetype** [Prophesied Monarch](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=294)

**Frequency**
once per day

**Prerequisites**
[Prophesied Monarch Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=7403)

</column>

---

You declare your current foes as irredeemable enemies, calling your allies down upon them. Speak your decree; all your knights who hear your decree can use their reaction to [Stride](/Actions.aspx?ID=2305) up to twice directly toward an enemy and then [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) that enemy if it’s within their reach or range.

When you speak a Decree of War, you can spend a [Mythic Point](/Rules.aspx?ID=3320) as part of the action to let every individual within a 10-mile radius around you at that moment know that war has come to your kingdom. You and your knights are able to gain access to free food, lodging, and repairs of common items while within the affected area for the next month, as allied citizens and creatures come to your aid. During this time, you also receive at least 10-minutes’ warning whenever an enemy group of more than 10 creatures travels in your direction, as allied scouts report to you.
name: Decree of War

    right="Feat 18"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Eternity-Incinerating Blaze](/Feats.aspx?ID=7189) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Exemplar" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=839" />
<trait label="Ikon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=840" />
<trait label="Void" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=510" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 42

</column>

---

The blaze of your divine spark is hot enough that it burns in not just the present, but the past and future as well. Whenever you score a critical hit with the imbued ikon, the target becomes doomed 1 or increases its doomed condition by 1. If the target’s maximum dying value is reduced to 0 by this ability, it immediately dies in a flash of spiritual fire that reduces its body to ash. This effect applies even when the ikon is not empowered. The ikon also gains the following transcendence ability.

**Transcendence—Burn out of Time** <actions string="Two Actions" /> (spirit, transcendence, void) An impossible amount of energy blazes in a sphere above you before compressing itself into your weapon. Strike one creature. The Strike deals an additional 3d8 spirit damage and 3d8 void damage. If the creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it’s immediately killed and reduced to ash, not in the present, but in the recent past, erasing the consequences of their recent actions. If a creature died within the last round as a result of the incinerated target’s actions, that creature is returned to life with 5d8 Hit Points at the location that it died as its death is retroactively undone.
name: Eternity-Incinerating Blaze

Raising your weapon or fist aloft, you begin to gleam with dazzling radiance. You fulminate with power and glory, making it clear to all who see you that your legend is real and possibly even greater than purported. Spend a [Mythic Point](/Rules.aspx?ID=3320).  All enemies who can see you must succeed at a Will saving throw against your class DC or become [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) 3 (frightened 4 on a critical failure). You and any ally who can see you may choose to [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) or [Stride](/Actions.aspx?ID=2305) as a free action. Any of these Strikes are made at mythic proficiency.

</title>

<traits>

<column gap="tiny">

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Mythic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=835" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 116

**Archetype** [Ascended Celestial](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=289)

**Prerequisites**
[Ascended Celestial Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=7331)

</column>

---

Your senses are enhanced by your divine spark, enabling you see things as they truly are, piercing through illusions, transformations, and lies. You’re affected by a constant [_truesight_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1727) spell. Additionally, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [Sense Motive](/Actions.aspx?ID=2302) and to Perception DCs against attempts to [Lie](/Actions.aspx?ID=2389) to you. When a creature attempts to Lie to you, they roll the [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=38) check to Lie twice and use the worse result; this is a [misfortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=654) effect.
name: Eyes Unclouded

>
[Fated Duel](/Feats.aspx?ID=7414) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Mythic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=835" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 137

**Archetype** [Prophesied Monarch](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=294)

**Frequency**
once per week

**Prerequisites**
[Prophesied Monarch Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=7403)

</column>

---

You and your knights are an unbeatable force together, but sometimes it’s a monarch’s duty to resolve the fate of their kingdom with nothing more than their own trusted weapon. Spend a [Mythic Point](/Rules.aspx?ID=3320), and choose one opponent within 30 feet; you declare a Fated Duel against that opponent. 

If the opponent accepts your challenge, you’re locked in mystical combat together. Neither you nor your opponent can move more than 30 feet from each other; you both can’t be harmed by any creature other than each other; and you both can’t harm any creature other than each other. This mystical bond is incredibly draining on both parties, pulling at their life and spirit; if neither you nor your opponent has defeated the other by the time 1 minute has passed, you both become [doomed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=67) 1. Your doomed conditions increase by 1 for each additional minute that passes until one or both of you die.

If your opponent refuses your challenge, you regain a Mythic Point and can immediately attempt an [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) check at mythic proficiency to [Demoralize](/Actions.aspx?ID=2395) them.
name: Fated Duel

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Champion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=24" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Divine Mysteries](/Sources.aspx?ID=234) pg. 277

</column>

---

Your features reshape into those of a type of [fiend](/Traits.aspx?ID=600) who serves your [deity](/Rules.aspx?ID=2048); for example, as a [demon](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=387) you might have putrid scales, twisted horns, and red eyes. You gain a [fly Speed](/Rules.aspx?ID=2350) equal to your Speed. You gain [darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=2410) if you don’t already have it, and you gain the fiend trait and the trait appropriate to the type of servitor you’ve become (such as [daemon](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=386), demon, or [devil](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=389)).
name: Fiendish Form

>
[Fight Choreography](/Feats.aspx?ID=7644) <actions string="" />
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Curtain Call</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #204: Stage Fright](/Sources.aspx?ID=245) pg. 83

**Archetypes** [Acrobat](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=236) (Level 18), [Gladiator](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=251) (Level 18)

**Prerequisites**
[Acrobat Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=6240) or [Gladiator Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=6333); master in Theater Lore

</column>

---

You’ve spent enough time training in stage fighting and teaching a wide range of stunts that you can prepare your companions with directions on how to avoid peril in battle. [Five Breaths, One Death](/Feats.aspx?ID=7015) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Tian Xia Character Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=230) pg. 90

**Archetype** [Five-breath Vanguard](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=272)

**Frequency**
once per 10 minutes

**Prerequisites**
[Induce Imbalance](/Feats.aspx?ID=7013)

**Requirements**
You're in an elemental stance, and the target is under the effects of Induce Imbalance.

</column>

---

You cycle through the elements in a devastating combination attack. [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) the target using the unarmed attack associated with your current elemental stance, then Cycle Elemental Stance. Then, Strike the target with the unarmed attack associated with your new elemental stance. You can continue to Cycle Elemental Stance and Strike until you’ve made a Strike using the unarmed attack of every elemental stance you know, applying the multiple attack penalty as usual. If you successfully hit the target with all five elemental Strikes using this ability, it must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC or die as each elementally associated organ within its body shuts down; this is a [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=571) effect.

You reabsorb the magic of your _spellsurge_ aura to power a piece of powerful magic. Spend a [Mythic Point](/Rules.aspx?ID=3320). Your _spellsurge_ ends. Regardless of the result, the target becomes immune to Guiding Words for 10 minutes.

>
[Hell of 1,000,000 Needles](/Feats.aspx?ID=4265) <actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Metal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=505" />
<trait label="Overflow" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=506" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 31 <sup>2.0</sup>

</column>

---

The landscape fills with monumental filaments of metal. The needles lance into a cube 30 feet on a side within 500 feet. Each creature in the area takes 13d6 piercing damage, with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save against your class DC. Each creature that fails its save is impaled, becoming [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=24) until it [Escapes](/Actions.aspx?ID=79) (the DC is your class DC); a creature that critically failed is also [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) as long as it's impaled.

 The hell remains until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute. Using this impulse again ends any previous one. The first time you Sustain it each round, lightning crisscrosses the needles. Each creature in the area takes 3d12 electricity damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save against your class DC. Squares in the area are [hazardous terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=454). A creature takes 6 piercing damage for every square of the area it moves through.

---
**Level (20th)** The initial damage is 17d6, and the hazardous terrain damage is 7.
name: Hell of 1,000,000 Needles

>
[Ignite the Sun](/Feats.aspx?ID=4250) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Light" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=100" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 29 <sup>2.0</sup>

</column>

---

The fires of creation become yours to control. You create a miniature sun in a 5-foot burst within 500 feet. A creature takes 7d6 fire damage any time it's in the miniature sun, with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save against your class DC. A creature can take this damage no more than once per round. The sun sheds [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407) in a 500-foot emanation (and [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408) for another 500 feet); this is sunlight for creatures with a particular vulnerability to sunlight.

 The sun lasts until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute. The first time you Sustain the impulse each round, you can choose to increase the size of the sun's burst by 5 feet, then make it Fly up to 30 feet. The sun can move through creatures, damaging them as described above.

 The sun continually channels fire into you and your allies. You and each of your allies within the sun's light deal an additional 1d6 fire damage with all Strikes, spells that deal fire damage, and [impulses](/Traits.aspx?ID=502) that deal fire damage (except for Ignite the Sun itself). These aren't cumulative with multiple suns.
name: Ignite the Sun

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Bard" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=546" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 107 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Prerequisites**
Trained in [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), Trained in [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10), or Trained in [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13); [Esoteric Polymath](/Feats.aspx?ID=4583)

</column>

---

Your esoteric formulas are so unusual that they allow you to dabble in magic from diverse traditions that other bards don’t understand. As long as you’re trained in Arcana, you can add arcane spells to your book from Esoteric Polymath; as long as you’re trained in Nature, you can add primal spells to your book; and as long as you are trained in Religion, you can add divine spells to your book.

Like your other spells in your book, you can add one of these spells from another tradition to your repertoire as an occult spell each day using Esoteric Polymath, but you can’t retain any spells from another tradition when you prepare again, even if you have Eclectic Polymath.

**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 112 **Archetype** [Archfiend](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=288) **Prerequisites** [Archfiend Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=7320) **Requirements** Your last action dealt damage to a creature. --- Rather than grant your foes the mercy of a swift death, you can consign them to suffer in an extradimensional prison with an appearance of your choosing. Spend 1 [Mythic Point](/Rules.aspx?ID=3320) to force a creature that you dealt damage to with your last action to attempt a Will saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Regardless of the result, the target is temporarily immune to your Imprison Foe for 24 hours. **Critical Success** The target is unaffected.
**Success** The target is [stunned](/Conditions.aspx?ID=93) 2.
**Failure** The target is transported into a cell within your extradimensional dungeon for 1 minute. It is unable to leave or damage the cell in any way. [Teleportation](/Traits.aspx?ID=710) effects can’t carry the target outside the cell unless they can also traverse the planes, such as [_interplanar teleport_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1576). At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration it is imprisoned by 1 round or end it entirely on a critical success. When the duration ends, the target returns to the space it occupied when it was imprisoned, or to the nearest space if the original is now filled.
**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target is [stunned](/Conditions.aspx?ID=93) for the first round it is imprisoned.
name: Imprison Foe

>
[Improbable Elixirs](/Feats.aspx?ID=5800) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Alchemist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=812" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 69 <sup>1.1</sup>

</column>

---

Your mastery of alchemical secrets enables you to replicate effects most believe can be achieved only via magic. Select a number of [potions](/Traits.aspx?ID=672) equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1); these potions must be of 9th level or lower. You gain formulas to create these potions as alchemical consumables with the [elixir](/Traits.aspx?ID=589) trait. When making these alchemical elixirs, you can substitute alchemical reagents for an equal value of magical components, and you can use an [alchemist's toolkit](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2702) (for [Quick Alchemy](/Actions.aspx?ID=2801)) or an [alchemist's lab](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2701) (for the [Craft](/Actions.aspx?ID=2385) activity) instead of any other required toolkits. Other than that, the formula doesn't change. Once you've chosen the potion formulas, they can't be changed.

[Improved Swift Banishment](/Feats.aspx?ID=4700) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Cleric" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=554" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 121 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Prerequisites**
[Swift Banishment](/Feats.aspx?ID=4692)

</column>

---

You easily banish creatures with your weapon. You can use Swift Banishment as long as you have a spell slot of 5th rank or higher remaining, even if you don’t have banishment prepared. You must sacrifice a prepared spell of 5th rank or higher, and the banishment effect you create is heightened to the rank of that spell. The target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to its save as though you’d paid the extra cost for banishment.
name: Improved Swift Banishment

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 25 2.0 --- An illusion of a limitless expanse with an impossibly blue sky makes all within feel the sensation of falling... forever. The vision appears in a 20-foot burst within 100 feet. The illusion lasts until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute. Using this impulse again ends any previous one. Each creature in the area or that later enters it must attempt a Will save against your class DC. Creatures with the air trait are immune. Any effect of the illusion ends for a creature as soon as it leaves the illusion's area or the impulse ends, and the creature then becomes temporarily immune for 1 hour. **Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Success** The creature is [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58).
**Failure** The creature is off-guard. It is [fleeing](/Conditions.aspx?ID=17) from the illusory sky but is also disoriented; any time it uses an action to attempt to flee, it must succeed at a DC 11 flat check or flee to a space that's still within the illusion. The GM determines where the creatures ends up, but the creature can't stay stationary if it's able to move.

Your deity empowers you to perform minor miracles, allowing you to readily adapt to the fluctuating needs of your duties. Once during your daily preparations, you can use a spell slot to hold sheer divine potential, rather than using it to prepare a spell. You can use this spell slot to cast any spell you know from the divine spell list that’s at least 2 ranks lower than the slot you designate. The spell acts in all ways as a spell of 2 ranks lower. You don’t have any particular spell prepared in that slot until you cast it.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="Mythic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=835" />
<trait label="Sanctified" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=519" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 132

**Archetype** [Godling](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=293)

**Frequency**
once per day

**Prerequisites**
[Godling Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=7392)

**Requirements**
Your hierophant invoked your judgment on their previous turn

</column>

---

To prevent yourself from frivolously calling down the terrible power of divine wrath, you have vowed to do so only with the assent of your mortal hierophant. If your hierophant successfully Strikes a target, they can spend a single action to invoke your wrath. On your turn, you can then Pass Vengeful Judgment on the target, calling down a scouring pillar of divine energy that deals 20d10 [spirit](/Traits.aspx?ID=737) damage with a basic Fortitude save. You do not need to have line of effect to the target and it functions at any range. If one of your current domain spells can deal a type of damage other than spirit, you can choose to match this damage type (for instance, calling down a flaming pillar that deals [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604) damage if you have the [fire](/Domains.aspx?ID=76) domain).

If you spend a Mythic Point as part of Passing your Vengeful Judgment, the blast extends into the heavens, scattering the clouds in a detonation visible to all creatures within a 10-mile radius as a show of wrath and a warning to those who would dare harm your followers or question your commandments. For the next month, you and your hierophant gain a +2 status bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) checks against creatures in the area.

**Special** If you have [Font of Life or Death](/Feats.aspx?ID=7399) , you can choose for the damage type to be [vitality](/Traits.aspx?ID=509) (if you chose heal) or [void](/Traits.aspx?ID=510) (if you chose harm) when you use this ability.

If the creature fails its save and takes damage, it is also drained 2 (or drained 4 on a critical failure) and you regain 1 Focus Point, up to your usual maximum, as your patron grants you additional magic in exchange for your gift of your opponent’s spirit.

    right="Feat 18"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Powerful Sneak](/Feats.aspx?ID=4988) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rogue" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=687" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 177 <sup>2.0</sup>

</column>

---

You’ve learned to exploit your enemies’ openings. Your sneak attack damage ignores any immunity or resistance the target has to precision damage. In addition, when you Sneak, you can designate one creature you’re undetected by at the end of that action. On the next attack you make against that creature before the end of your next turn, any sneak attack die you roll that’s less than 3 is a 3 instead. This has no benefit if your next attack against the creature doesn’t deal sneak attack damage, and if you designate a new creature you lose the benefit on any previous one.
name: Powerful Sneak

<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 18"
    pfs=""
>
[Profane Bargain](/Feats.aspx?ID=7329) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="Divine" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=579" />
<trait label="Mental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=647" />
<trait label="Mythic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=835" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 113

**Archetype** [Archfiend](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=288)

**Prerequisites**
[Archfiend Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=7320)

</column>

---

You can strike a profane bargain with a willing, sapient creature. That creature promises to never take [hostile actions](/Rules.aspx?ID=2251) against you, to never [lie](/Actions.aspx?ID=2389) to you, to never speak of this bargain, and to either perform, or refrain from performing, one other specified task, such as paying you a specified sum every year, gifting you their first-born child, or never speaking. 

If the target accepts, they verbally make a request. You can choose to twist their request by selecting specific details, as long as you still fulfill the requirements of their request. If the request could be granted by a [_wish_](/Rituals.aspx?ID=125) ritual, you spend 1 Mythic Point and the request is magically granted. 

As long as the bargain persists, you always know the target’s location, can communicate telepathically with the target at any distance, and can see through the target’s senses by taking a single action that has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561) trait. Once per day, you can take control of the target as an activity that takes three actions and has the concentrate trait. When you do, they become [controlled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=64) by you for 10 minutes. They have no memory of their time spent under your control.

If the target ever breaks the terms of this bargain, you immediately select one of the following punishments: they die, they die and you possess their soul, they become permanently controlled by you, or they become imprisoned in a cell within your realm’s dungeon (you must have the [Imprison Foe](/Feats.aspx?ID=7330) feat to select this final option).

A target can only enter into a Profane Bargain with you once—not even the breaking of this bargain, death, a _wish_ ritual, or divine intervention frees them of this limitation. You can’t make a Profane Bargain with yourself.
name: Profane Bargain

</title>

<traits>

**Prerequisites**

</column>

---

You have tied yourself so absolutely to the cause of liberty that your very existence is an act of rebellion. You ignore any [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) effects without the [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=598) trait that would rob you of your agency (for example, on a failed save against [_charm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1463) you would still be able to take hostile actions, and against [_laughing fit_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1583) you would still be able to take reactions but would remain [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92), but on a critical failure against fear you would still be fleeing because it’s a fear effect). Additionally, you are [immune](/Rules.aspx?ID=1609) to effects that would imprison your soul (such as [_seize soul_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1664), or a [final blade](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1094)).

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Earth" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=55" />
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Polymorph" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=127" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 27 <sup>2.0</sup>

</column>

---

Rock overflows from within you to consume your form before cracking open to reveal your body transformed into living stone. You gain 40 temporary Hit Points. You're immune to critical hits and precision damage. You can't be [pushed, pulled](/Rules.aspx?ID=451), or tripped while you're standing on earth or stone. Your earth [Elemental Blasts](/Actions.aspx?ID=2125) deal an additional 1d10 damage of their normal type. These benefits last until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain them up to 1 minute. After you gain temporary Hit Points from this impulse, you can't do so again for 10 minutes.

---
**Level (20th)** You gain 50 temporary Hit Points.
name: Rebirth in Living Stone

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Wizard" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=735" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 205 <sup>2.0</sup>

</column>

---

You’ve discovered how to reuse some of your spell slots over and over. You can spend 10 minutes to prepare a spell that you already cast today, regaining access to that spell slot. The spell must be of 4th rank or lower and can’t have a duration. You can reprepare a spell in this way even if you’ve already reprepared that spell previously in the same day.

 If you have the spell substitution arcane thesis, you can instead prepare a different spell in an expended slot, as long as the new spell doesn’t have a duration. You can use spell substitution on that slot again, but you remain restricted to preparing only spells without a duration in that slot until the next time you make your daily preparations.
name: Reprepare Spell

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Overflow" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=506" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
<trait label="Water" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=165" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 33 <sup>2.0</sup>

</column>

---

Booming, crashing walls of water, enough to fill a harbor, smash out ahead of you, overwhelming all in their path. The waves move forward in your choice of a 60-foot cone or 120-foot line. If you're in water, you can increase these waves to a 90-foot cone or 180-foot line. Each creature in the area takes 10d10 bludgeoning damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save against your class DC. A creature that fails its save is [pushed](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 20 feet (or 40 feet on a critical failure). Any unattended object of 1 Bulk or less in the area is pushed to the far edge of the area. The sheer mass of water extinguishes all non-magical flames in the area.

 As the wave crashes down, you can catch it to your destination. After the impulse deals damage, you can [Swim](/Actions.aspx?ID=39) in a straight line to any point in its area before the water disappears.
name: Ride the Tsunami

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Overflow" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=506" />
<trait label="Plant" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=125" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
<trait label="Wood" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=508" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 35 <sup>2.0</sup>

</column>

---

Terrifying trees attack your enemies. Three Large trees appear in unoccupied spaces within 500 feet, at least 15 feet from one another. Each tree has AC 40, Fortitude +33, Reflex +24, Will +30, and 200 HP. The trees can flank, but are unable to move. When the trees appear, each makes a Strike; they share a multiple attack penalty. The tree's melee Strike is a branch that has reach 10 feet; on a hit, the target is [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=20) by the tree ([Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79) DC 40). The ranged Strike is a hurled fruit, gourd, seed, or stone with a range increment of 60 feet. Either Strike has a +30 attack modifier and deals 4d10+9 bludgeoning damage.

 The trees last until the end of your next turn, and you can Sustain the impulse. Each time you Sustain the impulse, you can have one tree make a Strike.

---
**Level (20th)** The attack modifier is +32 and the Strike damage is 5d10+9.
name: Rouse the Forest's Fury
